english.title: Responsible person fail to ensure wild / semi-wild equine treated with veterinary medicinal product has ID / transponder
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), ]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility and]_

which was without an ID in a designated area and treated with a veterinary medicinal product, failed to ensure that the equine had an ID and was implanted with a transponder within 30 days of the treatment and in accordance with Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17, 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
